subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: What canonical public Gateway activity and attention contract should OpenClaw expose for per-session busy, waiting, stale-run, and child-session state?
rationale: The need is well supported, but the request adds a public Gateway protocol and session-state model; current code only has coarse `sessions.list` active-run flags and open PR candidates do not establish maintainer-approved semantics.

options.title: Approve a canonical activity contract
options.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundaries, stale-run handling, authorization, and child rollup before merging implementation work.

options.title: Adopt a narrowed candidate PR
options.body: Pick one open PR as the implementation base and require it to match the approved API boundaries before merge.

options.title: Defer the public surface
options.body: Keep existing coarse status and diagnostic paths for now while leaving this issue open for a later protocol decision.

recommendation.title: Approve a canonical activity contract
recommendation.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundaries, stale-run handling, authorization, and child rollup before merging implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live issue assignee and has recent Gateway/protocol-adjacent history, making them the clearest available decision owner.
